name: switch-window
title: Switch Window
description: Switch window of same app based on currently focused window and/or desktop
author: abdur_rehman_khalil

commands.name: switch-window-last-focused
commands.title: Switch Window Last Focused
commands.subtitle: Window Management
commands.description: Switch to the last window of current app on currently focused desktop

commands.name: switch-window-last-visible
commands.title: Switch Window Last Visible
commands.subtitle: Window Management
commands.description: Switch to the last window of current app across all visible desktop (on multiple screens)

commands.name: switch-window-next-focused
commands.title: Switch Window Next Focused
commands.subtitle: Window Management
commands.description: Switch to the next window of current app on currently focused desktop

commands.name: switch-window-next-visible
commands.title: Switch Window Next Visible
commands.subtitle: Window Management
commands.description: Switch to the next window of current app across all visible desktop (on multiple screens)

commands.name: switch-window-prev-focused
commands.title: Switch Window Prev Focused
commands.subtitle: Window Management
commands.description: Switch to the previous window of current app on currently focused desktop

commands.name: switch-window-prev-visible
commands.title: Switch Window Prev Visible
commands.subtitle: Window Management
commands.description: Switch to the previous window of current app across all visible desktop (on multiple screens)

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
